description: This file defines the Catalyst controller for managing purchase lists within the Coocook project. It includes actions for listing, editing, creating, updating, deleting, and managing purchase lists, as well as assigning articles to shop sections and setting default lists.

classes.name: Coocook::Controller::PurchaseList
classes.description: Catalyst controller class for managing purchase lists, including actions for listing, editing, creating, updating, deleting, and assigning articles to shop sections.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list all purchase lists, including calculating totals and URLs for actions.

methods.name: base
methods.description: Chained action to load a specific purchase list by ID and stash it.

methods.name: edit
methods.description: Handles GET requests to display the edit page for a purchase list, including shop sections, articles, and dishes.

methods.name: assign_articles_to_shop_section
methods.description: Handles POST requests to assign articles to a shop section, creating a new section if needed.

methods.name: make_default
methods.description: Sets a purchase list as the default for the project.

methods.name: move_items_ingredients
methods.description: Moves selected items and ingredients from one purchase list to another.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new purchase list with a specified date.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the name of an existing purchase list.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a purchase list, ensuring it is not the default if other lists exist.
